tools.name: get_board_format
tools.description: Returns the Math Board text format with a complete example. Read it before writing a board, unless you already have it.

tools.name: check_board
tools.description: Checks a board text without publishing it. Returns what the board understood, page by page, and every problem with its line and how to fix it. Fix every ERROR, then call check_board again. When there are no errors, call publish_board.

tools.name: publish_board
tools.description: Publishes a board and returns a link that opens it in the user's browser. Call check_board first. A board with errors is not published: the problems come back instead. Give the link to the user exactly as returned.

tools.name: read_board
tools.description: Reads the board behind a Math Board link the user gave you and returns it as board text, in the same format you write. tools.name: add_to_board
tools.description: Adds board text to the board the teacher has open, behind a live link (.../live/<id>). place "current_page": put it under what is on the page the teacher is on (write ONE page: the next step, a hint, a drawing). place "new_pages": add your pages after the last page (exercises, answers, a new topic).
